# Connectors

Read, list and delete connectors, the API descriptions that tools come from.

**Library:** [Maitento](index.md#maitento), for apps. More in [Tools](../../../concepts/tools.md).

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`ConnectorDelete`](#connectordelete) | Deletes a connector. |
| [`ConnectorGet`](#connectorget) | Returns a connector's definition, with every version. |
| [`ConnectorList`](#connectorlist) | Returns the connectors in a namespace. |

### ConnectorDelete

Deletes a connector.

```c
void ConnectorDelete(string name)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The connector: `name`, or `name@namespace`. |

Name the connector as `name`, or `name@namespace` for one in another namespace of your tenant; a name without `@` is looked up in this app's namespace.

It is refused while a tool is built on it (`Connector '…' is used by tool(s): …`), or while a definition still pins an older version of a tool built on it: delete or change those first. A deploy creates the connector again if your project still has its file. Fails with `Not found` when there is no such connector, and `Namespace '…' was not found.` when the namespace doesn't exist.

### ConnectorGet

Returns a connector's definition, with every version.

```c
jsonObject ConnectorGet(string name)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The connector: `name`, or `name@namespace`. |

**Returns** `jsonObject`: The connector, as a JSON object.

Name the connector as `name`, or `name@namespace` for one in another namespace of your tenant; a name without `@` is looked up in this app's namespace.

A connector describes the HTTP endpoint (or MCP server) a tool calls. The JSON object starts with `$type` (`openapi` for an HTTP endpoint, `mcp` for an MCP server), then holds `id`, `name`, `namespaceId` and `versions`. An `openapi` version has `httpMethod`, `url`, `pathParameters`, `queryParameters`, `requestSchema`, `responseSchema`, `authenticationType` and `description`. A connector holds no credentials: the tools that use it give them.

Fails with `Not found` when there is no such connector, and `Namespace '…' was not found.` when the namespace doesn't exist.

### ConnectorList

Returns the connectors in a namespace.

```c
jsonArray ConnectorList(string namespaceName)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string`, can be empty | The namespace to list. Pass `""` for this app's own namespace. |

**Returns** `jsonArray`: A JSON array of connectors.

Each element of the JSON array is a connector as [`ConnectorGet`](#connectorget) returns it. Fails with `Namespace '…' was not found.` when the namespace doesn't exist.
